text: Preserve the existing protocol 1.4 input compatibility: a safe integer can arrive as a JSON number or as a canonical decimal Long string. String-only peers remain readable without a breaking protocol change. Unsafe numeric inputs remain refused because JavaScript may already have rounded them. Strings must round-trip through Long.toString, rejecting whitespace, positive plus signs, padded zeros, exponent spelling and negative zero. The writer normalizes safe values to JSON numbers and emits larger values as canonical decimal strings. Focused codec tests pin acceptance and canonical re-encoding on JVM and JS.
